summary: Vivos Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an October 7, 2026 Stock Purchase and Exchange Agreement with a board member. The director bought 250,000 shares of Series D Convertible Preferred for $250,000 and exchanged 385,302 Series C Preferred shares for an equal number of Series D shares, leaving no Series C outstanding and 635,302 Series D shares with an $0.08 conversion price. The issuance was exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Rule 506(b). This is a related-party capital-structure simplification, not a special situation; watch dilution and governance.
